name: azelaic acid + niacinamide + salicylic acid
purpose: Purpose Acne treatment, exfoliation Fades dark spots, antibacterial Reduces oiliness, improves skin tone
uses: Use -Treats acne and prevents breakouts -Fades post-acne dark spots and hyperpigmentation - Brightens skin tone and improves texture -Reduces excess oil and unclogs pores
otcwarn: Do not use If allergic to any ingredient (especially tea tree oil). On broken or severely irritated skin. With other acne medications unless directed by a doctor Skin becomes excessively red, swollen, or painful. No improvement after 8 weeks of use.
